hints.title: Disjoint Half-Open Interval Tracking
hints.text: Maintain non-overlapping sorted intervals [left, right) representing tracked ranges to allow ordered boundary resolution.

hints.title: Binary Search Overlap Interval Splicing
hints.text: Use binary search to locate all intervals overlapping with target [left, right). For addition, combine overlapping intervals into one union. For removal, trim overlapping ends.

hints.title: RangeModule Operations Blueprint
hints.text: In addRange(left, right): merge min(overlapping lefts) and max(overlapping rights) and replace. In queryRange(left, right): check if a single interval completely encloses [left, right). In removeRange: replace overlapping intervals with non-overlapping trimmed fragments.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) for add/remove, O(log N) for query
variables: N: number of disjoint intervals stored
complexity.notes: Linear interval rebuild for add/remove maintains strictly sorted disjoint segments allowing binary search query in O(log N).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tracking individual integers up to 10^9 exhausts memory and time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Merged interval storage stores O(N) endpoints rather than point representations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling half-open boundaries and partial interval splitting correctly on remove.

solutions.approach: Disjoint Sorted Interval List Merging and Trimming
